summary: The base workplace plus the PHP toolchain: PHP 8.2 with the extensions the projects use, Composer, a database server, and the native build toolchain for the frontend part.

tools.name: php
tools.note: with xml, mbstring, curl, zip, gd, ldap, sqlite3, mysql, pgsql, bcmath, intl, and pcov as the coverage driver

tools.name: mariadb-server
tools.note: for test suites that need a real database. No systemd here and you are not root: initialise a data directory in your home once (mariadb-install-db --datadir=~/.local/share/mariadb) and start mariadbd yourself against it. Put that directory in a place you are willing to lose — it is scratch, not memory.

tools.name: node
tools.note: for the asset build; npm global installs land in ~/.npm-global

tools.name: build-essential, python3
tools.note: so npm packages with a native part (sharp, bcrypt, node-sass) build instead of failing halfway

tools.name: chromium
tools.note: used by the browser plugin, headless

notes: PHP 8.2 is the version the target projects' CI runs. Do not install another one — a suite that is green against a different minor version turns the pipeline red.
A database is here. Do not download one into your home — a server unpacked from a tarball costs 1.4 GB in every sync, for good.
No JDK and no Flutter here. This workplace is for PHP work; if your ticket needs another toolchain, that is worth saying out loud rather than fetching it into your home.
You are not root and apt is not available to you. If a tool is missing, say so instead of building a way around it — that is a request, not a defeat.
